title: Complementary one-sided probabilistic languages
statement: Fix a verifier model $E$ and a language $L$ of Boolean lists. Then $L$ is in complementary one-sided probabilistic polynomial time relative to $E$ exactly when the complement of $L$ is in one-sided probabilistic polynomial time relative to $E$.
